id: title:charlesvien:skip the boot claude login probe unless the flag is on

review.posthog_relevance: Desktop agent CLI availability and failure handling
review.reason: Adds a 2s SIGKILL grace period after a 15s status timeout and clears the timer on exit; P1.F1 adds a parametrized test checking both the 15s timeout and the subsequent SIGKILL, including the case where the CLI ignores SIGTERM. P1.F2 adds the constant and nested timeout. This is a localized, bounded implementation and test addition.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the observed implementation and test addition. No independent verification of actual adoption, incident avoidance, or user benefit is available. The tier does not account for unverified outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains five hunks across three files. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F2.H1/H2 are tightly coupled: P1.F2 adds a new constant and a nested timeout, P1.F1 adds the corresponding test. P1.F3 and P1.F4 are also tightly coupled: P1.F4 adds early-return and access recalculation, P1.F3 adds a test for that early-return. No other hunks are present. No unrelated PRs are indicated. No adoption
